text:
lina: Heads-up: running a focused entitlement cleanup dry-run in staging tomorrow 09:30 PT. Scope: stale admin roles, KMS grant resync, and validating audit-log continuity. Posting quick plan here.

tom: Appreciate the ping. Can you list exactly which services are in the canary and the abort criteria?

lina: Canary services: auth-svc, billing-worker, feature-flagger. Abort if more than 1 service gets >1% 401 errors or if audit playback shows any missing KMS revoke/create events.

ops-bot: creating sandbox snapshot now. Snapshot id: snap-20260325-0930. Artifacts: s3://redwood-dryruns/snap-4167000123.tar.gz

lina: Steps: 1) run owner scan (tags + ticket lookup) 2) exclude keys with external grantees 3) remove admin grants from ownerless roles in canary 4) run KMS revoke/create on test key and check CloudTrail + audit-proxy playback 5) collect traces and rollback if needed.

infra-monitor: I'll watch token refresh rates and pod restart counts. Set me a threshold callback for 0.5% token error and 5 restarts in 5m.

security-engineer: For replay, record CloudTrail and audit-proxy timestamps. If replay misses events, we need immediate forensics: save raw CloudTrail window and open sec-ticket.

lina: Commands for the KMS step (staging):
```
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-service-key --grant-id 9876-abcd
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-service-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-service-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

tom: Also grep CloudTrail for kms:RevokeGrant and kms:CreateGrant for that key id. If any grant ops are cross-account, skip those keys.

lina: Will add that filter. Will also tag the change with ticket #SEC-8942 for traceability.

ops-bot: export complete. checksum: sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015

infra-monitor: Starting watch window at 09:30 PT. I'll post alerts here if thresholds hit.

lina: Canary run done. Observations: auth-svc showed a single transient 401, recovered after reattaching grant. CloudTrail + audit-proxy both show matching revoke/create for the test key. No missing events.

tom: Nice. Can you draft a short blameless note for support about expected transient 401s during prod? Also recommend a 30m maintenance window for prod sweep.

lina: On it. I'll open RFC for prod cadence and include rollback playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/sec/admin-entitlement-rollback. Thanks everyone.

security-engineer: Good dry-run. Next: schedule weekly staging passes, then prod in small batches.
